pages.text: The $(item)Filament Winder$() turns raw materials into Filament Units. Put a $(l)material$() in the input slot and an empty (or partial) $(item)Filament Spool$() in the spool slot; the winder consumes the material and winds its FU onto the spool.$(br2)One universal winder handles $(l)every tier$(): the spool's tier, not the winder, decides what it accepts.
The Filament Winder: string, sticks, and a smooth-stone base. Craftable from Tier 1.

pages.title: What It Accepts
pages.text: The winder enforces the $(l)exact-tier$() rule: a material only winds into a spool of its own tier. If you load a mismatched spool, the GUI shows $(l)"Requires Tier X Spool"$().$(br2)Items with no FU value (un-priced blocks in strict mode) show $(l)"Can't be converted"$() and are left untouched. Bamboo is $(l)recyclable$() now, but trivially-farmable outputs like bones are $(l)held back$() from winding so they can't be laundered into filament (they still print).

pages.title: Filament Converter
pages.text: With $(l)Applied Energistics 2$() installed, the $(item)Filament Converter$() automates winding from an ME network and keeps docked spools topped up. Set its filter by right-clicking it with an item.
